messages:
nina: Quick request 3 benchmark visual kit we can reuse across blog, slide, and socials. Need modular pieces so PMs can swap numbers later.

omar: What shapes / data do you want?

nina: Three lanes (hosted / dedicated / private), latency curve + a small inset for cost per 1k tokens. Keep text editable and components named.

zara: Send seed CSV and export sizes pls.

nina: CSV sample (use exact values for mock): deployment,median_ms,cost_per_1k
hosted,46,0.80
dedicated,29,1.50
private,61,1.20

omar: Sizes: 1600x900, 1200x600, 1080x1080. SVG + PNG. Also Lottie stub for webinar intro (6s).

leo: Brand tokens: #1F3BFF, #00B37E, #101316. Provide high-contrast alt and color-blind palette. Add legal placeholder: "internal benchmark results - pending review" as text layer.

zara: Deliverables: Figma master, EXPORTS page with named artboards, redlines doc with WCAG checks, alt text. I'll localize copy to JA/DE later; include {JA_COPY} {DE_COPY} placeholders.

design-bot: QA: attach CSV, verify contrast >=4.5:1, keep type native, tag exports with locale/version. :white_check_mark:
